dict.string: An excellent one-click EFI configuration tool based on OpenCore
Defines PNLF device with a _UID of 14 for backlight control

IMEI fake device is only needed on 6-series boards with IVB CPU; X230 is QM77 (7-series) where MEI already reports 0x1E3A, so this only adds a duplicate _ADR 0x00160000 node under PCI0 - disabled for A/B
Replacement DMAR table with Reserved Memory Regions stripped - requires DMAR table be dropped
Fixing WakeScreen issues - called by SSDT-SleepHook
Fixing LED issues - called by SSDT-SleepHook
SSDT-PM for i5-3230M (ssdtPRGen v21.5, plugin-type handled for Ivy Bridge)
EHC1 to EH01 rename - AppleUSBEHCIPCI only matches EH01/EH02
EHC2 to EH02 rename - internal hub (BT/camera/fingerprint) hangs off EHC2
